name: Multivariable Calculus: Nablix
subtitle: Multivariable calculus 3
shortDescription: Adaptive multivariable calculus (calculus 3): 3D labs, quizzes and worked solutions, from partial derivatives to Stokes. Free to use.
longDescription:
Nablix is an adaptive multivariable calculus (calculus 3) course, from vectors and partial derivatives to multiple integrals, line and surface integrals, Green's theorem, Stokes' theorem and the divergence theorem.

### How it adapts
Adaptive practice follows your mistakes, and spaced review brings back fading topics. Choose the personalised path or the traditional syllabus order, and switch any time.

### Interactive labs
Rotate surfaces, roll gradient descent downhill, probe divergence and curl, and slice double integrals.

### Practice and understanding
Original problems with full worked solutions, placement, unit checkpoints and timed mock exams. Tap any concept for a plain-language refresher from earlier maths, with notes on what comes next. Cited university courses and textbooks open in a clear source window with the licence and a link.

Free to use. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never during a test, and every worked solution stays free. An optional monthly plan removes ads. All teaching text is original. Not affiliated with any university, publisher or exam body.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
